title: User login with email and password
story: As a registered user, I want to log in using my email and password so that I can access my account.
acceptance_criteria:
Scenario: Successful login with valid credentials
  Given a registered user with valid credentials
  When the user enters the correct email and password
  And clicks the login button
  Then the user is redirected to the dashboard

Scenario: Login fails with incorrect password
  Given a registered user
  When the user enters a valid email and an incorrect password
  Then an error message "Invalid email or password" is displayed

Scenario: Login fails with incorrect email
  Given a registered user
  When the user enters an invalid email and a valid password
  Then an error message "Invalid email or password" is displayed

Scenario: Login fails with invalid email and password
  Given a registered user
  When the user enters an invalid email and an invalid password
  Then an error message "Invalid email or password" is displayed

Scenario: Login with blank email
  Given the login page is displayed
  When the user leaves the email field blank and enters a valid password
  Then a validation message for the email field is displayed

Scenario: Login with blank password
  Given the login page is displayed
  When the user enters a valid email and leaves the password blank
  Then a validation message for the password field is displayed

Scenario: Login with blank email and password
  Given the login page is displayed
  When the user leaves both fields blank
  Then validation messages are displayed for both fields

Scenario: Account locks after five failed attempts
  Given a registered user
  When the user enters invalid credentials five consecutive times
  Then the account is locked
  And the user is informed that the account is locked

Scenario: Login attempt after account is locked
  Given the user's account is locked
  When the user enters valid credentials
  Then login is denied
  And an account locked message is displayed

Scenario: Password field masks entered characters
  Given the login page is displayed
  When the user types a password
  Then the password characters are masked

Scenario: SQL injection attempt in email field
  Given the login page is displayed
  When the user enters "' OR '1'='1" as the email
  And enters any password
  Then login is denied
  And the application safely rejects the malicious input

Scenario: Cross-site scripting attempt in email field
  Given the login page is displayed
  When the user enters "<script>alert('XSS')</script>" in the email field
  Then the application sanitizes the input
  And login is denied
test_cases:
Scenario: Successful login with valid credentials
  Given a registered user with valid credentials
  When the user enters the correct email and password
  And clicks the login button
  Then the user is redirected to the dashboard

Scenario: Login fails with incorrect password
  Given a registered user
  When the user enters a valid email and an incorrect password
  Then an error message "Invalid email or password" is displayed

Scenario: Account locks after repeated failed attempts
  Given a registered user
  When the user enters incorrect credentials 5 times in a row
  Then the account is locked
  And the user sees a message indicating the account is locked

title: Password reset via email
story: As a user who forgot my password, I want to reset it via an emailed link so that I can regain access to my account.
acceptance_criteria: User can request a reset link via email
Reset link expires after 30 minutes
New password must meet complexity rules
User is notified after successful reset
test_cases:
Scenario: Successful password reset request
  Given a user with a registered email
  When the user requests a password reset
  Then a reset link is sent to their email

Scenario: Expired reset link is rejected
  Given a user has an expired password reset link
  When the user clicks the link
  Then an error message indicating the link has expired is shown

Scenario: New password fails complexity rules
  Given a user is on the reset password page
  When the user submits a password shorter than 8 characters
  Then an error is shown indicating password requirements were not met

title: Add item to shopping cart
story: As a shopper, I want to add products to my cart so that I can purchase multiple items at once.
acceptance_criteria: User can add an in-stock item to the cart
Cart quantity updates in real time
Out-of-stock items cannot be added
Cart persists across sessions for logged-in users
test_cases:
Scenario: Add in-stock item to cart
  Given a product is in stock
  When the user clicks "Add to Cart"
  Then the item appears in the cart with quantity 1

Scenario: Attempt to add out-of-stock item
  Given a product is out of stock
  When the user views the product page
  Then the "Add to Cart" button is disabled

Scenario: Cart persists after logout and login
  Given a logged-in user has items in their cart
  When the user logs out and logs back in
  Then the cart still contains the previously added items

title: Apply discount coupon at checkout
story: As a shopper, I want to apply a discount coupon at checkout so that I can get a reduced price on my order.
acceptance_criteria: Valid coupon reduces order total correctly
Expired or invalid coupons are rejected with a clear message
Only one coupon can be applied per order
Coupon discount is reflected in the order summary
test_cases:
Scenario: Apply valid coupon
  Given a shopper has items in their cart
  When they enter a valid, active coupon code
  Then the order total is reduced by the coupon amount

Scenario: Reject expired coupon
  Given a shopper enters an expired coupon code
  When they apply the coupon
  Then an error message "Coupon expired" is displayed and total remains unchanged

Scenario: Prevent stacking multiple coupons
  Given a shopper has already applied one valid coupon
  When they try to apply a second coupon
  Then the system rejects the second coupon with a message explaining only one coupon is allowed

title: Upload profile picture
story: As a user, I want to upload a profile picture so that my account feels personalized.
acceptance_criteria: Supports JPG and PNG formats
Max file size is 5MB
Image is resized/cropped to a square thumbnail
User sees a preview before saving
test_cases:
Scenario: Successful profile picture upload
  Given a user selects a valid JPG image under 5MB
  When they upload the image
  Then the image is saved and displayed as their profile picture

Scenario: Reject unsupported file format
  Given a user selects a .gif file
  When they attempt to upload it
  Then an error message indicating unsupported format is shown

Scenario: Reject file exceeding size limit
  Given a user selects an image larger than 5MB
  When they attempt to upload it
  Then an error message indicating the file is too large is shown

title: Search products by keyword
story: As a shopper, I want to search for products by keyword so that I can quickly find what I'm looking for.
acceptance_criteria: Search returns relevant results ranked by relevance
Search handles typos with suggestions
Empty search shows a helpful message
Results can be filtered by category and price
test_cases:
Scenario: Search returns relevant results
  Given products exist matching a keyword
  When the user searches for that keyword
  Then matching products are displayed ranked by relevance

Scenario: Search with no results
  Given no products match the search keyword
  When the user searches
  Then a message "No products found" is displayed with suggestions

Scenario: Filter search results by price range
  Given a user has searched for a keyword
  When they apply a price filter
  Then only results within that price range are shown
